stem.en: Yeast, hydra and moulds can increase their numbers quickly by asexual reproduction. When does this happen best?

text.en: When there is no food or moisture anywhere around them

feedback.en: Spores wait for moisture and nutrients. Hard conditions do not speed things up.

text.en: When two parents are found close to each other

feedback.en: Asexual reproduction needs only one parent.

text.en: When the temperature falls close to freezing

feedback.en: Low temperatures slow or stop the reproduction of moulds.

text.en: When the conditions around them are favourable

feedback.en: Yes. Mitosis is fast, especially when conditions are favourable.

explanation.en: Mitosis is fast and helps organisms increase quickly, especially when environmental conditions are favourable, such as warmth, moisture and food for a mould.
